target_cpu: Cortex-M7, Thumb, FPv5 double-precision FPU, hard-float ABI
evidence_basis: Prior public MP-3 FCC board images identify MIMXRT1176; physical unit revision not verified
model_subset_in_arm_module: NAM v0.5/v0.6 mono single-layer LSTM with hidden size <=16
current_embedded_model: Upstream hidden-size-3 correctness fixture, not a quality amp capture
tasks_before_bootable_firmware: Prove actual loader handoff, vector placement and image validation rules
Establish bootloader-preserving write/erase boundaries and independent recovery entry
Implement board startup, clock tree, memory layout, MPU/cache configuration and hardware math/runtime linkage
Implement AK4619 codec reset/configuration and verified SAI/eDMA input/output routing
Handle DMA buffers/cache coherence, interrupts, physical controls, power and output muting
Measure physical target CPU deadline, stack, memory and thermal/power behavior
Design phone/Bluetooth transport, model storage and atomic preset/chain changes
no_assumption: No loader command or approved physical flash address. Candidate RAM/code addresses are conditional offline experiments.
board_components: target/board; codec bus logic, descriptor builder, Q31 adapter, compile-only reset entry
remaining_audio_work: Clock PLL initialization and lock handling
TX periodic trigger source and RX/TX phase
Physical slot mapping, analog mute/power sequencing
Timing and audio operation on physical target
historical_scope: Earlier small-LSTM board module and stock-chain milestones; these tests do not establish standalone A2 hardware operation.
